review: Middle Don is an ID focused on Absolute Resonance mechanic with main focus being on Envy. Middle Don gets additional increased Offense Level from A-Reson. Meaning her clash values can be rather deceiving. While her damage is decent at base, her main source comes from Counter that turns into Envy Skill 3… and here come issues of having to get hit, needing 6+ A-Reson. (which at the moment of writing this review counts two groups of 3 as A-Reson. Which makes it easier to achieve it than needing lining up one after another but A-Reson. suppose to be uninterrupted chain). Additionally, team build around Middle Don and Envy is rather awkward. Either we pick heavy hitters with Envy S3 or those with S2 and S1 which will make nuke turns rather weak compared to other setups. No notable E.G.O. Synergies
